{{Quote|Minka and I are from the capital of Cantros Seven. How about you?"<br />"I'll bet we were neighbors once&hellip;it's a big town.|Sami and a Cantrosian Rebel|<ref name="Meow" />}}
A '''large town''' on the [[Cantrosian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Cantros 7]] served as its [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. [[Minka]] and [[Sami (Cantrosian)|Sami]], as well as at least one of their fellow Cantrosians, were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in the capital.<ref name="Meow" />
